# Copilot Instructions

## Project overview
Campus X Mart is a campus marketplace app with a FastAPI backend and a React frontend. The project is being hardened for production readiness while keeping the classroom demo workflow working.

## Working rules
1. Do only the phase I name, then stop. Begin with a short plan (files to create, change, delete), then implement. Pause for my input only if something is ambiguous or destructive.
2. Work step by step and run the relevant checks after each step.
3. Every behavior change gets a pytest test (FastAPI TestClient + real PostgreSQL) that would have failed before the change. Frontend changes must keep `npm run lint` and `npm run build` passing.
4. Run the checks yourself and report the real output. If you cannot run something, say so. Never claim a check passes unless you ran it.
5. Never commit, push, or rewrite git history, and never run `git add -A`. For git changes, print the exact commands for me to run.
6. Never print, log, or write secrets. Do not copy the current hardcoded DB password into any file, test, command, or message.
7. Ask before: deleting files that aren't explicitly approved, adding a dependency not named in the phase, making a destructive schema change (dropping or renaming columns/tables), or changing an API contract the frontend uses. If a contract changes, update the frontend in the same phase.
8. SQL always uses query parameters; never interpolate user input.
9. Keep diffs focused: no drive-by reformatting or renames. Comments only where they explain why.
10. Schema changes go in database/migrations/NNN_name.sql (idempotent) and are mirrored into database/schema.sql.

## Phase 1: safety net, config, hygiene, urgent security
0. Persist context: create .github/copilot-instructions.md containing the Working rules above plus a two-line project overview, and docs/ROADMAP.md containing the Roadmap section below, verbatim.
1. Config: add backend/settings.py (pydantic-settings; add it to requirements.txt) reading environment variables and backend/.env: APP_ENV (dev|test|prod, default dev), DATABASE_URL (required), JWT_SECRET_KEY (required, at least 32 chars, must not equal the old placeholder "change-this-development-secret-before-deployment"), JWT_EXPIRES_MINUTES, CORS_ORIGINS (comma-separated string parsed to a list; default the two localhost:5173 origins), OPENAI_API_KEY, CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME, CLOUDINARY_UPLOAD_PRESET, EXPOSE_DEV_OTP (default false; used in Phase 2). The app must refuse to start with a clear message if a required value is missing. Replace every hardcoded or os.getenv config read (database.py, main.py, llm_assistant.py, the seed script) with settings, and remove the `from backend.database import ...` try/except hack. Add backend/.env.example with placeholders only, plus the command that generates a secret. Update the README run instructions.
2. Seed safety: database/seed_200_rows.py TRUNCATEs every table on import. Move the logic into main(), require APP_ENV=dev and an explicit --yes flag, and refuse otherwise.
3. Hygiene: add a root .gitignore (venv/, .venv/, __pycache__/, *.pyc, .env and .env.* except .env.example, node_modules/, dist/, .DS_Store, *.orig, *.pkl, market_report.pdf, uploads/, .pytest_cache/, .ruff_cache/). You may delete: frontend/src/App.jsx.orig, frontend/src/App.css (confirm nothing imports it), unused files in frontend/src/assets (grep first), and backend/test_marketplace_features.py (replaced in step 4). Remove the unused `openai` and `scikit-learn` from requirements.txt. Add backend/requirements-dev.txt (pytest, pytest-cov, httpx, ruff).
4. Test harness: backend/pytest.ini (pythonpath = ., testpaths = tests) and backend/tests/conftest.py. It reads TEST_DATABASE_URL, sets the env vars the app needs before importing it, aborts unless the database name ends in `_test`, rebuilds the schema from database/schema.sql once per session, and truncates between tests. Fixtures: client, make_user(role, verified), auth_headers, make_item. Tests: register then login; an unverified user cannot create a listing but a verified one can; plus every item in step 5.
5. Urgent security, each with tests:
   a. Delete GET /api/users (nothing uses it).
   b. Add a require_admin dependency. /api/reports/market-summary and /api/reports/download become admin-only; generate the PDF in memory and return it; never write to /tmp or return a server path.
   c. POST /api/locations, POST /api/upload/image and POST /api/assistant/chat require a logged-in user (anonymous gets 401). Locations take a Pydantic JSON body instead of query parameters. Update the frontend upload call to send the Authorization header.
   d. Fix /graphql: annotate the handler parameter as `request: Request`, return {"data": ...}, and run the blocking schema execution in the threadpool. Test `{ hello }` and `{ item(itemId: 1) { name } }` (graphene camel-cases argument names).
   e. Test that building Settings without JWT_SECRET_KEY raises.
6. CI: update .github/workflows/ci.yml. Backend job: postgres:16 service, `ruff check` (only pyflakes F and E9 rules for now; do not reformat the codebase), `pytest -q`. Frontend job: `npm ci`, `npm run lint`, `npm run build`. If lint already fails on existing frontend code, fix only trivially safe errors and list the rest in your report; do not refactor App.jsx in this phase.

## Definition of done
pytest, ruff, npm run lint and npm run build all pass; the app refuses to start without required env vars; a search for password literals in backend/ and database/ finds no credentials.

## ROADMAP
- Phase 1: safety net, config, hygiene, urgent security (this prompt).
- Phase 2, auth and abuse hardening: stop returning OTPs (only if APP_ENV=dev and EXPOSE_DEV_OTP=true); sender abstraction (console + SMTP email; SMS pluggable); max 5 attempts per code using the unused verification_codes.attempt_count, plus a 60 s resend cooldown; UI resend button, remove "Demo codes" and pending_verification_codes from localStorage; rate limiting (slowapi) on login, register, verify, resend, assistant, upload; upload hardening (size cap, magic-byte check for jpeg/png/webp, remove the base64-in-DB fallback: dev = local uploads/ via StaticFiles, prod = signed Cloudinary upload); one-time WebSocket ticket instead of the JWT in the URL; server-side video_url validation (YouTube only).
- Phase 3, correctness and integrity (test-first; migrations in database/migrations/): sort keys price_asc, price_desc, newest, name_asc (the UI sends "price-asc", which the API silently ignores), stable tie-breaker, escape % and _ in search; item_media dedupe + UNIQUE(item_id, sort_order) + upsert on edit (each edit currently inserts a duplicate row and duplicates the card); orders: price set server-side from the item, only AVAILABLE items orderable, seller can decline a PENDING order, item becomes RESERVED on CONFIRMED and SOLD on COMPLETED and returns to AVAILABLE if a confirmed order is cancelled, at most one confirmed/completed order per item (partial unique index), SELECT ... FOR UPDATE on transitions; 404/409 instead of 500 (existence checks + FK/unique violation handlers), soft-delete items that have orders; reviews only from buyers with a COMPLETED order, no self-review, return review text and a seller rating; GET reactions returns current_reaction; GET messages must not mutate, must validate the receiver, and must paginate; conversation list with last message + unread count; notifications: mark read, read-all, unread count, pagination; single seed path with real password hashes, a real ADMIN user, a categories table + GET /api/categories, unique index on locations.
- Phase 4, backend structure: split main.py into app/{core,db,schemas,routers,services}; connection pool + get_db dependency (commit/rollback); no async def doing blocking I/O; Decimal for money; response_models; Alembic baseline; structured logging with request IDs; hardened Dockerfile (non-root, healthcheck); pg_trgm/full-text search and an index on item_media(item_id); remove duplicated/dead code (ml/).
- Phase 5, frontend: split App.jsx (pages/components/hooks/api client); React Router (/items/:id, /sell, /items/:id/edit, /my-listings, /orders, /messages, 404); TanStack Query; AuthContext with auto-logout on 401; toasts instead of alert(); server-side sort/filter only; readable condition/status labels; categories from the API; show the user's own reaction; ONE chat WebSocket for the app lifetime (selected user in a ref, guard onclose by socket identity, reconnect with backoff) and load messages for the auto-selected conversation; edit/delete/mark-sold UI, seller info and "Message seller" on the item page, unread badges; accessibility (label/htmlFor, buttons instead of clickable divs, aria-labels on stars and like buttons, focus states); YouTube ID parsing + iframe sandbox; lazy images; mobile nav; page title/favicon; error boundary; Vitest + Testing Library for login, browse and sell flows.
- Phase 6, product features and polish: campus email-domain allowlist (ALLOWED_EMAIL_DOMAINS); password reset; refresh tokens in an httpOnly cookie (user_sessions table); per-listing conversations; seller profiles; favorites; multiple images; offers; report/block plus an admin moderation dashboard on the existing reports table; real-time notifications over WebSocket; AI: category suggestion in the sell form (small scikit-learn model trained on items, with whole-word keyword fallback) and a natural-language search assistant that maps to filters, honestly labelled AI vs rule-based; price/condition/location filters; Leaflet + OpenStreetMap using locations.latitude/longitude; docker-compose (db + api + web), pre-commit, README rewrite (screenshots, architecture diagram, demo accounts), align PROJECT_CHECKLIST.md with reality, rename feaures.md.
